stories.title: Fifteen Flintshire roads closed today, with Bagillt worst hit
stories.summary: Drivers in Bagillt face four sets of roadworks at once this week, with part of the A5026 closed until Friday. The A5026 at Lyons Den and Bagillt Road is shut for highways maintenance until Friday 20 November, according to Flintshire County Council’s roadworks list. stories.title: Energy bills forecast to rise by £443 a year in the new year
stories.summary: Energy bills are forecast to rise by £443 a year from January, the same month nearly 50,000 Flintshire households are due a £100 Welsh Government payment towards their costs. stories.title: UK inflation rises for fourth month in a row, with fuel the biggest reason

stories.title: Power back on in Hawarden after early morning issues
stories.summary: Update, 06:45 18 Nov: SP Energy Networks says power has been restored. Earlier report: Part of Hawarden is without power this morning after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 9.26am. stories.title: North Wales councils asked for 5% to stand still. The draft budget guarantees 2.5%
stories.summary: Senior officers at Flintshire and five other North Wales councils told the Welsh Government they needed a funding rise of at least 5% just to keep services at their current level.
